license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to work, for compensation, as a master plumber, journeyman plumber, or plumber's apprentice without being registered and licensed as a plumber in such classification.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of plumbing.

name.quote: "Board" means the state board of plumbing.

type.quote: The state board of plumbing shall consist of the chief sanitary engineer, or the director of the department of environmental quality, and four persons appointed by the governor.

required.quote: Any person qualified under the rules of the board who desires to take the examination to become a registered and licensed plumber shall make application to the board therefor and pay to the treasurer of the board the examination fee.

experience_source.quote: Any person qualified under the rules of the board who desires to take the examination to become a registered and licensed plumber shall make application to the board therefor and pay to the treasurer of the board the examination fee.

exams.name: Plumber licensing examination (master or journeyman)
exams.notes: Examination fee not to exceed $200 for master plumber, $100 for journeyman plumber. Board prescribes time and place. Applicant has right to review failed examination.
exams.quote: If upon examination the applicant is found by the board to be qualified as a master plumber or journeyman plumber, or both, it shall issue to the applicant a certificate of registration and license

interval_years.quote: A certificate and license issued under the provisions of this chapter is valid for only one year and expires on the thirty-first day of December of the year in which it was issued.

required.quote: each applicant for renewal of a master or journeyman plumber's license under section 43-18-17 must have successfully completed prior thereto at least two credit hours, and thereafter a minimum of two credit hours and not to exceed four credit hours within a two-year period, of continuing education relating to the plumbing trade.

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of two credit hours and not to exceed four credit hours within a two-year period

available.quote: The board may register, without examination, upon payment of the required fee, nonresident applicants registered under the laws of other states having requirements for regulating plumbers which the board determines are substantially equivalent to the requirements of this state

requirements.value: Nonresident applicants registered under laws of other states with substantially equivalent requirements; available only when such other state grants similar privileges to North Dakota residents licensed under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an offense with a direct bearing on the holder's ability to serve the public as a plumber, or insufficient rehabilitation following conviction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of an offense determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon the holder's ability to serve the public as a plumber, or the board determines, following conviction of any offense, that the holder is not sufficiently rehabilitated under section 12.1-33-02.1

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing" means the installation, maintenance, extension, alteration, and removal of all piping, plumbing fixtures, plumbing appliances, and other appurtenances in connection with bringing water into, and using the same in buildings, and for removing liquids and water-carried wastes therefrom.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" means the installation, maintenance, extension, alteration, and removal of all piping, plumbing fixtures, plumbing appliances, and other appurtenances in connection with bringing water into, and using the same in buildings, and for removing liquids and water-carried wastes therefrom.

methods_authorized.quote: the installation, maintenance, extension, alteration, and removal of all piping, plumbing fixtures, plumbing appliances, and other appurtenances

license_tiers.quote: Prescribe rules and regulations not inconsistent with the provisions of this chapter for the examination, regulation, and licensing of plumbers, either as master plumbers, journeyman plumbers, plumber's apprentices, or any of such classifications.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A plumber's apprentice must work under the immediate and personal supervision of either a master or a journeyman plumber.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: any person other than a journeyman or a master plumber, who, as the person's principal occupation, is engaged in learning and assisting in the installation, alteration, and repair of plumbing and drainage, under the immediate and personal supervision of either a master or a journeyman plumber.

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: No person, firm, corporation, or limited liability company shall engage in the business of installing plumbing and shall not install plumbing in connection with the dealing in and selling of plumbing materials and supplies in any location of this state having a public system of waterworks or sewerage, unless at all times a registered and licensed master plumber, who is responsible for the proper installation thereof, is in charge of such work.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: Employees of dealers in household appliances need not be licensed pursuant to this chapter when installing household appliances, if any necessary plumbing work is incidental to the installation of the appliance and the work could be performed by a plumber's apprentice.

continuing_education_hours_plumber.quote: a minimum of two credit hours and not to exceed four credit hours within a two-year period, of continuing education relating to the plumbing trade.
